name: Krimisodhini Gulika (Vati)

sections.introduction: Krimisodhini Gulika (Vati) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of effective herbs. This is far best known medicine for intestinal worms. The word krimi also refers to worms or parasites.
sections.ingredients:
Aqueous extract of – Butea monosperma 
 Teekshnavrikshaphala – Croton tiglium 
 Palasabeeja – Butea monosperma 
 Hing – Ferula asafoetida 
 Krishnajiraka – Nigella sativa 
 Tulasibeeja – Ocimum sanctum 
 Hiravi – Garcinia Morella 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take all the ingredients. 
 Powder all the ingredients individually and then mix well. 
 Add this powder mixture to the aqueous solution of herb palash. 
 Now make the paste and prepare pills from them. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 It is an Ayurvedic herbal formulation which is prepared using various herbs, effective in case of many gastric problems. It is used in the management of intestinal worms and parasites and also in all types of digestive disorders like diarrhea, bloating, gas distension. Use of this medicine is quite effective in case of diarrhea and manage their relative symptoms like abdominal pain, fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, watery diarrhea with mucous. It helps to manage the digestive system and improve the digestion. This medicine also has laxative action and helps to get relief from constipation. Besides these properties this remedy has properties to manage the shrunken chest, bloated belly, emaciated limbs, nocturnal fever and constant grumbling.

Krimisodhini Gulika (Vati) 
 Reference – Yogagrantham 
 Introduction 
 Krimisodhini Gulika (Vati) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of effective herbs. This is far best known medicine for intestinal worms. The word krimi also refers to worms or parasites. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Aqueous extract of – Butea monosperma 
 Teekshnavrikshaphala – Croton tiglium 
 Palasabeeja – Butea monosperma 
 Hing – Ferula asafoetida 
 Krishnajiraka – Nigella sativa 
 Tulasibeeja – Ocimum sanctum 
 Hiravi – Garcinia Morella 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients. 
 Powder all the ingredients individually and then mix well. 
 Add this powder mixture to the aqueous solution of herb palash. 
 Now make the paste and prepare pills from them. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 It is an Ayurvedic herbal formulation which is prepared using various herbs, effective in case of many gastric problems. It is used in the management of intestinal worms and parasites and also in all types of digestive disorders like diarrhea, bloating, gas distension. Use of this medicine is quite effective in case of diarrhea and manage their relative symptoms like abdominal pain, fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, watery diarrhea with mucous. It helps to manage the digestive system and improve the digestion. This medicine also has laxative action and helps to get relief from constipation. Besides these properties this remedy has properties to manage the shrunken chest, bloated belly, emaciated limbs, nocturnal fever and constant grumbling. 
 Indications 
 
 Intestinal worms 
 Constipation 
 Bloating 
 Nocturnal fever 
 Shrunken chest 
 
 Dose 
 Take two tablets during night, before meal with water. 
 Contraindications 
 Take under medical prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
